body:
While trying to add support for interpolation for multiple points/columns, I needed to extend on `TimeVaryingInputs0DExt` which was difficult to do given the current code. This PR refactors all of it using https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaAnalysis.jl/pull/418 as the basis for the refactor.

I used a LLM to write the code and I verified it.
title: Refactor TimeVaryingInputs0DExt
